metadata.description: Azure region for all resources.
Region for the Cosmos DB account only. Defaults to location; override (e.g. eastus2) when the main region lacks Cosmos capacity. The Cosmos private endpoint still lands in the spoke VNet in location.
Region for the Azure AI Search service only. Defaults to location; override when the main region lacks Search capacity. The Search private endpoint still lands in the spoke VNet in location.
Short prefix for resource names. Kept short because Key Vault and Foundry account names have length limits.
OpenAI model deployed on the Foundry model account and exposed through the gateway.
Version of the Foundry model deployment.
Capacity (thousands of tokens per minute) for the Foundry model deployment.
Address space for the spoke VNet.
Delegated Standard-Agent subnet (Microsoft.App/environments). Injecting the account here provisions the agent runtime + single-tenant data proxy.
Private-endpoint subnet (Foundry account, Storage, Cosmos, Search).
Internal-only private DNS zone for the gateway custom domain (a BYO-gateway VAN-URL analog). The self-signed cert SAN must match <customDomainHost>.<customDomainZone>.
Host label of the gateway custom domain, prepended to customDomainZone.
CIDR for the delegated subnet that hosts the nginx gateway container (Azure Container Instances).
Base64-encoded PEM of the self-signed gateway certificate (public cert). Emitted by bootstrap-cert; served by nginx on the TLS handshake the data proxy validates. Supplied by deploy.ps1.
Base64-encoded PEM of the self-signed gateway private key. Emitted by bootstrap-cert; used by nginx to serve the cert. Supplied by deploy.ps1.
Inference API version the Foundry ApiManagement connection sends to the gateway.
Name of the pre-created Key Vault that holds the root CA public-cert PEM secret (created by bootstrap-cert.ps1/.sh before this deployment).
Pinned version of the root CA public-cert PEM Key Vault SECRET. Only needed for the VERIFY phase (enablePrivateCaTrust=true); leave empty for REPRO. Emitted by the bootstrap script.

Name of the root CA public-cert PEM Key Vault SECRET (the trust anchor referenced by account.trustedCertificateSources). Must match the -SecretName used by the bootstrap script; deploy.ps1 forwards it automatically.

Two-phase test switch.
false (default) = REPRO: root CA NOT registered on the account; inference is expected to FAIL at the data proxy with certificate-not-trusted.
true = VERIFY: root CA (public PEM) registered in account.trustedCertificateSources; wait for the account update to succeed and trust to propagate, then inference is expected to SUCCEED.

variables.trustedCertificateSourcesProperty: [if(parameters('enablePrivateCaTrust'), createObject('trustedCertificateSources', createArray(createObject('type', 'AzureKeyVault', 'resourceId', resourceId('Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults', parameters('keyVaultName')), 'certificateBundleReferences', createArray(createObject('secretName', parameters('gatewayCaSecretName'), 'secretVersion', parameters('gatewayCaSecretVersion')))))), createObject())]

resources.name: [format('{0}/{1}/{2}', variables('foundryAgentAccountName'), format('{0}-project', parameters('namePrefix')), 'agents')]
dependsOn: [extensionResourceId(resourceId('Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts', variables('cosmosName')), 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments', guid(resourceId('Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts', variables('cosmosName')), resourceId('Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/projects', variables('foundryAgentAccountName'), format('{0}-project', parameters('namePrefix'))), variables('roleCosmosDbOperator')))]

testPhaseHint.value: [if(parameters('enablePrivateCaTrust'), 'VERIFY phase: trustedCertificateSources is registered. After the account update succeeds and trust propagates automatically, verify the stored references and re-run inference (expect success).', 'REPRO phase: trustedCertificateSources is NOT registered. Run inference through the connected model (expect certificate-not-trusted at the data proxy).')]
